column1: # Known-flaky browser checks. Tab-separated; blank lines and # lines are ignored.
# script  check  owner  added  expires  note
# check is a substring of the check name as run.sh prints it after FAIL. While an entry is active (today <= expires) the
# check still runs and shows red, but a red run.sh with only these failing is not a failed push (tools/ci/flakes.sh judge).
# The nightly runs each entry 5 times. An entry lasts 14 days: renew it with a new expires date and a note saying what
# was found, or fix the check and delete the line. An expired entry blocks again. See docs/test-tiers.md.
